NOT part of production yet. Scored by the same evaluator as the real suite, so the full metrics are comparable with it; only the taxonomy path differs.
meta.validation: production (frozen M4 validators, two attempts); consolidation: at most two attempts, then unavailable (no fallback to the unconsolidated taxonomy)

meta.matching: member-comment Jaccard ≥ 0.5, ties to the earlier gold topic; no name similarity

scenarios.description: Gold taxonomy and gold dispositions (harness sanity check; must score 100%).

expected.outcome: accepted first time; every metric perfect

topics.name: autofocus
topics.description: How reliably and quickly the camera finds and tracks subjects, including eye and subject detection and manual focus aids.

topics.name: image quality
topics.description: What the still images look like: detail, colour rendering, dynamic range, noise at high ISO and in-camera JPEG processing.

topics.name: video recording
topics.description: Shooting moving footage: resolutions and crops, codecs and log profiles, heat limits, rolling shutter and on-board audio.

topics.name: grip and handling
topics.description: How the body feels in the hand: size, weight, grip depth and where the physical dials and buttons sit.

topics.name: lens selection
topics.description: Which lenses exist for the mount, how good they are and how well adapted lenses work.

topics.name: image stabilization
topics.description: How well in-body and digital stabilization keep handheld stills and footage steady.

topics.name: menus and customization
topics.description: The on-screen menu system and how far settings, custom modes and button functions can be configured.

topics.name: viewfinder and screen
topics.description: The electronic viewfinder and rear display: brightness, lag, blackout, articulation and eye-sensor behaviour.

topics.name: ruggedness and sealing
topics.description: How sturdy the body is and how it copes with rain, dust, sand, cold and wear.

method.providerLabel: Two-phase topics (Oracle taxonomy generator (gold) + Oracle topic assigner (gold))

topics.name: photo quality and colour
topics.description: Stills quality (resolution, dynamic range, noise, banding, JPEG processing, lens rendering) plus colour accuracy, white balance, skin tones and built-in looks.

topics.name: autofocus and subject tracking
topics.description: Eye, face, animal and subject detection, tracking reliability, focus hunting, focus misses and AF behaviour in photo and video.

topics.name: ergonomics and controls
topics.description: Grip, weight, size, dial and button placement, joystick, touchscreen behaviour and physical handling comfort.

topics.name: video features and recording limits
topics.description: Video formats, log and raw, 4K crops, rolling shutter, slow motion, audio, missing exposure tools, plus overheating, shutdowns and recording time limits.

topics.name: image stabilization performance
topics.description: In-body, sensor-shift and digital stabilization effectiveness for stills and handheld video, including crops, jitter and real-world stops gained.

topics.name: lenses and mount ecosystem
topics.description: Native lens lineup and roadmap, kit lenses, third-party restrictions and adapted lens use.

topics.name: viewfinder and rear screen
topics.description: EVF quality, lag, blackout and refresh rate, plus articulating rear screen visibility and usability.

topics.name: battery and storage
topics.description: Battery life and drain, charging, card slots and card types, write speeds and file size.

topics.name: menus and customisation
topics.description: Menu organisation and learnability, settings naming, button remapping and custom modes.

topics.name: build and weather sealing
topics.description: Body construction, weather and dust sealing, cold and rain resilience, and wear or flimsy parts.

method.providerLabel: Two-phase topics (Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 (topic-discovery-v2) → consolidation (topic-consolidation-v3) + TypeSafe jev-latest (jev-topic-a1), batches of ≤ 25)
